nvitk.pipes.pesa_fat.dixon_v5.run¶

Dixon v5 pipeline master.

Entry point for the whole Dixon v5 pipeline (stages 1-3). Same shape as nvitk.pipes.pesa_fat.ct_pet_v5.run: dispatches each stage either locally (in-process loop) or on SGE (one array job per subject; tasks = stages with -tc 1 + done-markers). --base-hold should be set when a stage 0 job is already in queue so every subject’s array waits on its stage 0.

nvitk.pipes.pesa_fat.dixon_v5.run._stage_resources(stage: str, *, device: str = 'gpu') → nvitk.cluster.sge.SgeResources¶

Per-stage SGE resource request.

Stage 1 always uses the GPU h_vmem config. When device is "gpu", every stage requests ngpu=SGE_NGPU (so stages 2/3 run on a GPU node too); when "cpu", every stage requests ngpu=SGE_CPU_NGPU.

nvitk.pipes.pesa_fat.dixon_v5.run.submit_subject_chain(subject: str, lay: nvitk.pipes.pesa_fat.common.paths.BatchLayout, stages_sel: list[str], *, container: pathlib.Path, src_dir: pathlib.Path, backend: str = 'cupy', device: str = 'gpu', model_dir: pathlib.Path | None = None, overwrite: bool = False, regions: tuple[str, Ellipsis] = cfg.REGION_ORDER, base_hold: str | None = None, dry_run: bool = False, log_level: str = 'INFO', emit: TextIO | None = None) → list[str]¶

Submit one Dixon v5 SGE array job for a single subject.

Array tasks are the selected stages in order (-tc 1 + done-markers). base_hold is applied to the whole array (e.g. the subject’s stage-0 jid).

Returns [jid] (one array job id) so batch aggregate/QC can hold on it.
